title.narrative: Operating the Specialized Hospital for Ophthalmology and Surgery in Marib

description.narrative: . Treating specialized eye diseases and localizing the service for 200,000 beneficiaries.
Providing specialized medical care services for ophthalmology and surgery in Ma’rib Governorate and its districts for free, through the continued provision of specialized medical services.

• Securing the medical needs of eye patients. • Alleviating the suffering of eye patients. • Limiting travel abroad for the purpose of treatment; Which contributes directly to the economic stability of the state. • Localization of cadres and services in ophthalmology and surgery. • Improving and developing performance according to the specialized standards of ophthalmology and surgery.
